description:
About Multiply

Multiply is building the AI-native media agency for B2B companies, combining AI agents with expert strategists to transform how businesses run and optimize paid advertising.

Our platform connects to advertising channels, CRMs, and customer data to continuously create, manage, and optimize campaigns. We're building autonomous AI agents that make decisions, execute workflows, learn from results, and improve performance over time. We're also building a Marketing Intelligence platform that learns from thousands of campaigns and ads to uncover insights about buyers, creative performance, and channels, making every campaign and Ad smarter than the last.

We're a fast-growing, venture-backed startup tackling complex technical challenges at the intersection of AI, automation, and large-scale marketing data. Our goal is to fundamentally change how marketing gets done.



Role Description

We're looking for an exceptional AI-native engineer who loves building products, solving hard problems, and shipping fast.

As an early engineer at Multiply, you'll work directly with the founders to build and scale our AI-powered platform. You'll have significant ownership over product features, technical architecture, and engineering decisions.

This isn't a role where you'll be handed detailed specifications. You'll take ambiguous problems, figure out what matters, and ship solutions to customers. You'll work across the stack, from intuitive product experiences to sophisticated AI agents and backend systems.

You'll join a small, ambitious team in San Francisco where your work will have an immediate impact on our product, customers, and company.



What you’ll do

 - Build AI-powered products: Own and ship end-to-end features that customers use every day, from intuitive interfaces to complex backend systems.

 - Develop autonomous AI agents: Build agents that reason, plan, execute actions, and continuously improve marketing workflows.

 - Engineer reliable AI systems: Design agent orchestration, tool integrations, evaluations, observability, and feedback loops to make AI systems dependable in production.

 - Integrate data and build intelligence: Connect advertising platforms, CRMs, and other data sources to power intelligent automation, uncover insights, and improve decision-making.

 - Move fast with AI: Leverage AI coding tools and modern development workflows to prototype, build, and ship at exceptional speed without compromising quality.

 - Own problems end-to-end: Work directly with founders and customers to turn ambiguous ideas into working products, from initial design through production.

 - Shape our engineering foundation: Influence architecture, tooling, technical decisions, and engineering culture as the team grows.



What We Mean by "AI-Native"

AI isn't just a feature we're building — it's fundamental to how we build software.

We expect engineers to actively use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other AI-powered development tools to accelerate development, testing, and experimentation.

We're looking for engineers who constantly explore new AI capabilities, rethink traditional development workflows, and combine AI-driven speed with strong engineering judgment.



Qualifications

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building and shipping production applications across the stack.

 - Hands-on experience with modern AI development tools and a demonstrated ability to use them effectively.

 - Experience building AI-powered applications or workflows, ideally using LLMs or agents.

 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently take ambiguous problems from idea to production.

 - Product-minded engineering approach — you care about the user experience and business impact, not just the code.

 - Comfortable moving quickly, learning new technologies, and making pragmatic technical trade-offs.

 - High ownership, curiosity, and a bias toward action.



Bonus Points

 - Experience with agent frameworks, orchestration, tool calling, or evaluation systems.

 - Experience building integrations with third-party APIs or complex data systems.

 - Previous experience at an early-stage startup or building your own products.
